title: scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs: build a Serena ignore override from git's own ignore sources (producer for task-e3e81c45)
definitionOfDone: Against a fixture git repo whose big/ (holding nested .gitignore files) is excluded only in .git/info/exclude, with a tracked sub/.gitignore and a .serena/project.yml that sets ignored_paths, the script writes a .serena/project.local.yml whose content equals the expected text exactly. That text is: the walk off; "/.git" first; project.yml's entries; then the info/exclude pattern for big/ and the root and nested .gitignore patterns, converted as Serena converts them. A rerun prints the up-to-date line and leaves the file's bytes and inode unchanged. scripts/tests/serena-ignore.test.mjs proves it.

An existing project.local.yml keeps every byte outside the Moe block, and a previous block is replaced, never duplicated. MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_OVERRIDE=0, or a user part that sets ignore_all_files_in_gitignore or ignored_paths, removes a previous block and writes nothing else. Each of these is a test row.

Fail-open, one test row each: a non-git root; a subdirectory root; a broken repository (a .git file naming a missing gitdir); no git on PATH; MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 without an absolute MOE_PROTECTED_GIT; a project.local.yml that git does not ignore, and a tracked one; a symlinked project.local.yml; a begin marker without its end; an unreadable project.yml ignored_paths; a submodule; an untracked nested repository. Each prints MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_SKIPPED, exits 0, and leaves the root's files byte-identical.
scripts/bundle-manifest.json ships scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs, and the script imports only node: builtins.
`node --test scripts/tests/serena-ignore.test.mjs` passes on Linux and through Windows node.exe, and `npm run lint` exits 0.
